body:
Canonical successor for [danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5840](https://github.com/danielbaustin/agent-design-language/issues/5840).

## Migration semantics

- `replaces`: danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5840 as active current-repository WP-20 authority.
- `part_of`: #307, the coordination-only Sprint 6 umbrella.
- Legacy #5840 remains immutable provenance and is not claimed closed or terminal.
- This issue owns the bounded outcome in the archived source body; it does not absorb sibling work.
- This ceremony claims no implementation, review, publication, merge, release, or closeout progress.
- Entry gate remains terminal and ancestral legacy/current authority for WP-18 #5836, WP-18A #5837, WP-18B #5838, and WP-19 #5839.

## Archived source issue body

## Summary

Execute **WP-20** for v0.92 within this issue's approved design and ownership boundary.

Reconcile and validate v0.92 demo/AEE proof metadata after #5836, #5837, #5838, and #5839; do not implement child features, absorb WP-21/WP-21A reduction work, or declare milestone release readiness.

## Required Outcome

demo matrix, AEE proof routing or packet, proof coverage, and validation commands

## Deliverables

- Reconciled demo matrix and feature coverage table
- Exact-revision AEE and artifact index
- Corrected WP-20 versus WP-21/WP-21A ownership
- Fail-closed coverage validator and focused tests

## Dependencies

- #5836 / WP-18 complete
- #5837 / WP-18A complete
- #5838 / WP-18B complete
- #5839 / WP-19 complete

## Owned Paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92/DEMO_MATRIX_v0.92.md`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92/FEATURE_PROOF_COVERAGE_v0.92.md`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92/V092_ACTIVATION_BRIDGE_LEDGER_v0.92.md`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92/review/V092_DEMO_AEE_ARTIFACT_INDEX.md`
- `adl/tools/validate_v092_demo_proof_coverage.py`
- `adl/tools/test_v092_demo_proof_coverage.sh`
- `.csdlc/evidence/5840`

## Read-Only Inputs

- Every repository path cited outside `## Owned Paths` is read-only unless it is repeated exactly in that section.
- Dependency records, sibling issue outputs, historical evidence, and external systems remain read-only inputs.

## Validation And Proof

- Prove exact-revision parity across matrix, coverage, activation, and AEE index rows.
- Reject missing artifacts, duplicate owners, planned-as-passed, synthetic proof, and unsupported platform claims.
- Prove clean patch structure before exact-head review.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1: Matrix, coverage, activation-ledger, and artifact-index rows agree on owner, command, status, and exact revision.
- AC-2: Every accepted demo/AEE claim has positive artifact, required negative artifact, platform/credential posture, review state, and non-claims.
- AC-3: WP-20 demo/proof ownership is corrected without absorbing WP-21/WP-21A reduction work.
- AC-4: The validator rejects missing paths, duplicate ownership, planned-as-passed status, synthetic proof, and unsupported platform claims.
- AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

## Non-Goals

- Feature implementation or rerouting child ownership
- Repository-wide reduction or Rust refactoring
- Synthetic proof generation
- Milestone quality, publication, or release approval

## Rollback

Restore the previous demo matrix, feature coverage table, and activation
ledger, remove the new artifact index and validator changes, and retain the
rejected coverage report under issue evidence. Rollback must not alter child
proof artifacts or convert uncovered, failed, blocked, or planned rows into
accepted exact-revision proof.

## Execution Boundary

This issue is design-ready, not implemented. Execution must reverify terminal dependencies, create or reuse the issue's dedicated branch and worktree through the current `csdlc-bind` Git-topology route, retain the declared positive and negative proof, complete exact-head review, and use `Closes #308` in its implementation PR. No claim, lease, protected-path reservation, preparation generation, or SHA-pinned preparation receipt is required.
